Maya (Marketing): Quick plan: ship OSS refapp + three short tutorials + community webinar next Wed. KPIs: 500 repo views, 50 webinar signups, 10 trial conversions.
Liam (DevEx): I'll scaffold the repo and put 3 labs: quickstart, dedicated deploy, cost tuning. each lab = 10-15 mins.
Priya (Product Marketing): Need a short launch post and a benchmark blurb we can quote. Ravi, can you run a small perf sweep?
Ravi (Eng): Yes. I'll run tests on our staging GPU (fp16) and a quantized CPU run. Will provide CSV + one-paragraph summary: latency @128 tokens and cost/1k tokens.
Sam (Sales Ops): For capture: HubSpot form with utm_campaign=refapp_launch and webhook to #sales-inbound. I'll tag leads as "refapp_interest".
Juno (Community): Webinar format: 30m demo + 20m Q&A. Let's recruit one community power user to co-present — I'll reach out.
Maya (Marketing): Messaging variants: technical, value, enterprise. We'll A/B test hero CTA on landing page vs webinar registration. Priya to draft copies.
Liam (DevEx): Add Dockerfile + CI + CONTRIBUTING.md. Make issues ready for community contributions (good-first-issue).
Priya (Product Marketing): Also want a one-slide benchmark graphic and a short explainer paragraph for PR. Legal review required for claims.
Ravi (Eng): Noted — will flag instance and sequence assumptions.
Maya (Marketing): Timeline: Mon - repo + tutorial drafts; Tue - perf + graphics; Wed - landing + HubSpot; Thu - post draft + legal sign-off; Fri - dry run; Launch = next Tue.
All: ack?
Liam (DevEx): ack.
Priya (Product Marketing): ack.
Ravi (Eng): ack.
Sam (Sales Ops): ack.
Juno (Community): ack.
Maya (Marketing): Thanks — I'll post daily updates here. :rocket:
